title: Unit-normalized symmetric tensor comparison and total summand equations
statement: Let X be a scheme and U an open [def-pc-scheme], L the functor of Modules.overEquiv U and T its degreewise cochain functor. There exists a symmetric core monoidal structure m on L with unit isomorphism equal to overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U. For all integer cochain complexes P,F on the over-U site let D=Hom(P,O[0]) be the ordinary dual [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. There is an isomorphism c:T(Tot(F tensor D)) to Tot(TF tensor TD) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For every p+q=n its component satisfies L(iota_F,D,p,q,n);c^n = m.mu(F^p,D^q)^(-1);iota_TF,TD,p,q,n. Symmetry is the equality L(beta_A,B);m.mu(B,A)^(-1)=m.mu(A,B)^(-1);beta_LA,LB for all module sheaves A,B. There are no boundedness or homological hypotheses.

proof.text: Reindex module presheaves using PresheafOfModules.pushforward₀OfCommRingCat along the inverse open-site equivalence. Its existing monoidal structure is braided: on each section both composites swap the two pure tensor factors. Sheafification is monoidal and braided. Use exists_localizedOpen_sheafification_iso to supply the lifting isomorphism, and Mathlib Localization.Monoidal.functorMonoidalOfComp to construct a monoidal structure on L. Its lifting isomorphism is monoidal. The braided equation descends by Localization.natTrans₂_ext: on sheafification images it follows by cancellation of the sheafification tensorator from the braided equation for the composite. This constructs the structure directly within the proof, rather than selecting arbitrary module data from a mere existence theorem.

Normalize the resulting unit ε to the prescribed isomorphism e=overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U. Put b=e followed by ε inverse, an automorphism of the target tensor unit. The explicit natural automorphism s of the identity has s_A=λ_A inverse followed by b tensor id_A followed by λ_A. Naturality follows from whisker exchange and left-unitor naturality; s at the unit is b by equality of the unitors and right-unitor naturality. Transport the monoidal structure along the natural automorphism of L given by s_(L A). Its unit is ε followed by s_(L I)=b followed by ε=e. Naturality and the original braided equation give the braided equation for the transported inverse tensorator. These are fully proved private helpers in the assigned module, with no additional public hypotheses or unproved statements.

The open-site equivalence is additive and preserves coproducts. Use the inverse normalized tensorator in each bidegree; its oplax naturality in each factor proves the two differential equations. Two HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents constructions give a bicomplex isomorphism e₂. Compose inverse HomologicalComplex₂.mapTotalIso with HomologicalComplex₂.total.mapIso e₂. The summand equation follows by map_ι_mapTotalXIso_inv and ιTotal_map; the bidegree component of e₂ is definitionally the inverse tensorator. Use the existing tensorClosed theorem for monoidal preadditivity. The totalization API supplies the signs, and no boundedness condition is used.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ordinaryEvaluation_tensor_summands (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    let L := Equivalence.functor
      (C := localEvaluationModules X U)
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)
    let T := L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    ∃ m : L.CoreMonoidal,
      m.εIso = Scheme.Modules.overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U ∧
      (∀ A B : localEvaluationModules X U,
        L.map (β_ A B).hom ≫ (m.μIso B A).inv =
          (m.μIso A B).inv ≫ (β_ (L.obj A) (L.obj B)).hom) ∧
      ∀ P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ,
        ∃ c : T.obj (localEvaluationTensor X U P F) ≅
            pullbackTensorTotal U.toScheme (T.obj F) (T.obj (localEvaluationDual X U P)),
          ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
            L.map (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F (localEvaluationDual X U P)
                (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫ c.hom.f n =
              (m.μIso (F.X p) ((localEvaluationDual X U P).X q)).inv ≫
                HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (T.obj F)
                  (T.obj (localEvaluationDual X U P)) (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h
